theme: Tracing a contaminant plume back to its buried source
title: Well Field: Backtracking a Buried Contaminant Plume
strategies: minimum-norm least squares on the visible wells (naive baseline, fits data exactly but smears mass across correlated cells)
least squares + clip-and-rescale (still no sparsity commitment, trap-vulnerable)
orthogonal matching pursuit exploiting the <=3-active-cell sparsity prior + non-negative least squares refit on the small support (recovers the true source, generalizes to held-out wells)
